text:
Priya: Tiny emergency: lobby plant has staged a sit-in on the coffee table. It's now blocking the leaflets. Who do we send for diplomatic talks with the ficus?
Omar: I'm on ficus diplomacy duty. I brought snacks as a peace offering. :peace: :seedling:
Becca: Is this related to the Lilypad incident? I still mourn that succulent. :crying_cat_face:
Juno: Legend says the Lilypad moved itself after someone played whale sounds. Not a joke.
pantry-bot: Note: disposable gloves available in kitchen.
Max: I'm assembling a delegation. Priya + Omar + Max = Plant Treaty Committee. Titles pending.
Priya: Proposal: rename the lobby plant "Ambassador Leaf" and roster a weekly water courier. Anyone volunteer?
Omar: Volunteer for courier. Also proposing monthly moisturizing rituals.
Becca: I will help with the rituals if we can give Ambassador Leaf tiny sunglasses. Vibes matter. :sunglasses:
Juno: Vote: sunglasses yes, whale playlist no. The whale playlist traumatized the fern.
pantry-bot: Poll created: 1) Sunglasses 2) Weekly water courier 3) Whale playlist ban. Voting open for 6h.
Priya: Adding to lore: the "Lobby Lilypad" file in the breakroom ledger. We now have an official plant saga.
Max: Also drafting a tiny sign: "Ambassador Leaf: Please do not feed after 3pm."
Omar: Quick logistics: who has a tiny pair of sunglasses? I can 3D-print a visor.
Becca: I found a sticker pair in the supply drawer. They look like tiny cat shades.
Juno: If we get sunglasses, we must have a ribbon-tying ceremony. Low commitment, high joy.
pantry-bot: Poll closed. Results: Sunglasses 4, Weekly water courier 3, Whale playlist ban 2.
Priya: Sunglasses it is. Omar, you are the provisional Plant Diplomat. Max will be transport for the visor. Ceremony Friday at 3pm. Bring small offerings (coffee grounds accepted).
Omar: I'll bring a tiny ribbon too. This could be a great addition to our lore wall.
Becca: Creating a 2-slide "Ambassador Leaf" intro for Friday's micro-all-hands.
Juno: Can't wait. The Lilypad rises again.
Priya: Closing thread. Remember: please do not use the plant as a laptop stand. :seedling:
